notes.title: Intro Content Update
notes.content:
[h1][u][b]Tutorial Levels[/b][/u][/h1]

We got enough feedback saying we should add some Tutorial levels so Dan our lead programmer took the time to put together a content update featuring 3 new starter levels. Each explaining certain game features that weren't explained before but left to the player to discover.

A guide has also been added to help you on your path to success.
[h2][u][b]
All Features during this update[/b][/u][/h2]

- 3 new starter levels
- Guide to help you
- adjustments to Level 1 including a new checkpoint 
- bug fix for controller sensitivity
- New Pathway to climb upon in Level 1

[h3][b][u]To Conclude[/u][/b][/h3]

We hope this update greatly enhances the experience for those already enjoying Pillars of Fog and encourages future players to pick up the game!

Find out more information about us/what we're working on below:
[url=https://www.gabagoogames.ca/]gabagoogames.ca[/url]

[url=https://discord.gg/6gvz3VrJYN]GabaGoo Games Discord[/url]

Enjoy!
GabaGoo Games.

notes.title: Pillars Of Fog Full Release OUT NOW July/15th/2024
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=e_hAta5KMxQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][b][u]Pillars Of Fog Full Release[/u][/b][/h1]

Pillars Of Fog has been planned for over a year now and we've put a lot of work into our first 3D Platformer. We do have plans to update the game and add more to POF over time, but first we want to hear from the community and see what the feedback is from what we have now ready and running at Full Release. 

- You will Start from our first level and progress onwards by climbing up using our all math based climbing system. Procedural Generative Climbing, no animations used, just Math! 

 - The first checkpoint is very high up making the climbing part of our first level quite challenging so we'll have to see what player feedback is based off if we should potentially make it easier or maybe harder? Or just keep the level the same we'll see what the gaming community has for us. 

- Your first checkpoint will be through a purple portal where once entered you will be in level 2. Checkpoint levels will not use climbing as a center point to the gameplay but now this is when POF turns to a horror game. I won't spoil anymore, the rest is for you to experience now!

[h2][u][b]Our Links below to Learn more![/b][/u][/h2]
For More information you can always Join our Discord of 256 Members
[url=https://discord.gg/JxFAbGzwnt]GGG Discord[/url]
Or for even more information see our Website below
[url=https://www.gabagoogames.ca/]gabagoogames.ca[/url]
[u]
Possibly Known Bug? or weird feature?[/u]
- Set controls to default first time launching due to settings being set to none or just fill in controls to your liking.

notes.title: Pillars Of Fog | Hotfix | Patch 4 for 1.0 Full Release
notes.content:
In this hotfix, we've patched the game four times, and the fourth time's the charm! Here's what we've fixed:
[list]
[*] Lighting with Lens Flare: Resolved issues for better visuals and performance.
[*] Procedural Generative Climbing Controls: Smoothed out for improved gameplay.
[*] Neck Snapping: Fixed to ensure proper animations.
[*] Settings Menu: Buttons now recognized properly and settings save correctly.
[*] Performance: Increased by optimizing the settings menu and lighting in each map/level.
[/list]

That's all for now! If any bugs come up after release, please let us know through Steam reviews, our Discord, or email us at our support email for Pillars of Fog.
